root_idea.summary: The root centers on setting apart, restraining, or preventing passage between things, extending to limits, edges, sharpness, and resistance.
root_idea.development: A separating barrier becomes a marked boundary or prescribed limit; the notion of an edge develops into sharpness and into iron, named for its resistance, while prevention extends to opposition and legal restraint.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed as the QAC Form I opposition/prevention form, normalized to the perfect citation form حَدَّ.
Displayed separately because QAC identifies it as Form III and Lane supports its reciprocal opposition construction.
Displayed under the singular nominal citation form حَدِيد.
Displayed as the Quranic verbal noun حِدَاد.
Displayed under the singular dictionary citation form حَدّ for the Quranic plural حُدُود.

senses.definition: To prevent, restrain, or oppose; in the Quranic construction, to resist or set oneself against God and His Messenger.
senses.usage_conditions: Quranically attested in the imperfect form يُحَادُّونَ, with active opposition or resistance expressed through the root’s basic sense of prevention.

senses.definition: To oppose, contend with, or act toward another in reciprocal enmity.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic construction presents opposition to God and His Messenger; the Form III pattern emphasizes reciprocal contention or contrariety.
The Quranic noun denotes the familiar resistant metal, including iron used in implements, construction, and weaponry.

senses.definition: Sharp or piercing; of sight, perceptive and penetrating.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic usage فَبَصَرُكَ الْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ, the adjective describes sight or understanding as penetrating rather than merely denoting a physical edge.

senses.definition: Sharpness or cutting force, especially sharp, forceful speech.
senses.usage_conditions: In أَلْسِنَةٍ حِدَادٍ, the verbal noun functions descriptively of tongues whose speech has a sharp or cutting effect.

senses.definition: A limit or demarcating boundary, especially a limit that must not be crossed.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic plural حُدُود, the image of a boundary marks the permitted and forbidden sides of an ordinance and warns against transgression.

senses.definition: A divinely prescribed ordinance or legal limit, including rules of lawful and unlawful conduct and appointed penalties.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quran applies the plural حُدُودُ اللَّهِ to revealed rulings and their defined limits; the same terminology can include punitive provisions because they restrain recurrence and transgression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To inflict the legal punishment called حَدّ upon an offender.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The punishment is understood as restraining the offender from returning to the offense and deterring others.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To distinguish or separate one thing from another by a mark, note, or stated boundary.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of marking off a house or other thing from what adjoins it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To define a word or concept by a restrictive description.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical logical extension of marking out the limits of a thing’s meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To edge, sharpen, or point a blade, knife, sword, or similar object.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is made capable of cutting or piercing by working its edge or point.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To look sharply, intently, or attentively at something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of directing a sharp edge toward an object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To mourn for a deceased husband and abstain from adornment, perfume, and similar practices.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional mourning practice during the prescribed waiting period.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become sharp, edged, or pointed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used intransitively of a sword, knife, tooth, or similar object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sharpness, vehemence, or penetrating vigor in temperament, speech, intellect, action, or courage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes irascibility and forcefulness as figurative extensions of a sharp edge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To repair to or betake oneself to the limits or boundaries of a country, town, person, or thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II construction expressing movement toward a boundary or toward the object named.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of seed-produce, to emerge late and then grow pointed without forking into separate stalks.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized intransitive agricultural usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To border upon or be conterminous with another territory.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of adjoining lands or regions; this is distinct from the Quranic reciprocal-opposition construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become slender.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form VII usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To shave the pubic hair with an iron razor or similar implement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized usage derived from حَدِيد, iron.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Prevention, hindrance, restraint, prohibition, or an impediment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: As a noun, it can denote something that blocks or averts an action or harm.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bar, partition, obstruction, or separation between things or places that prevents commixture or encroachment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The separation may be between objects, locations, or persons.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The boundary or limit of a land or territory.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete geographic boundary, distinct from a legal ordinance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A restrictive logical definition specifying what makes a thing what it is.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical extension of delimiting a concept from others.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The end, extremity, or utmost point of a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the furthest point reached by an object, process, or condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The point or verge at which an event or condition is nearly reached.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use of an extremity or threshold.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The cutting edge or point of a sword, knife, spearhead, arrow, or similar object.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The part by which the object cuts or pierces.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Arms or weapons.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the expression ذَوُو حَدّ; the same expression is also interpreted figuratively as people of valor.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A side, region, quarter, or tract.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A spatial or positional sense that underlies some expressions of opposition or adjacency.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A station, standing, rank, or condition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of a person’s defined position or status.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A grammatical case.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical grammatical usage, as in being in the category of the nominative case.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A class or category.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical classificatory usage in grammatical description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A quarter or seasonal division of the year.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the expression حَدُّ الرَّبِيع, the quarter of spring.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small quantity of water, milk, or similar liquid remaining in a vessel or skin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sharpness of a sword, knife, or similar object.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun denotes the quality corresponding to a sharpened edge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Force, strength, pungency, or acrid intensity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of wine and similar substances, and of a quality marked by force or hardness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A way of avoiding or escaping a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the idiom مَا لِي عَنْ هَذَا الأَمْرِ حَدَدٌ and related expressions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Forbidden, prohibited, disallowed, or vain and false.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to an affair, act, or claim characterized as impermissible or invalid.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A formulaic call or imprecation invoking the averting of a person or harm; also a proper-name form associated with an impediment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in expressions such as حَدَادِ حُدِّيهِ and حَدَادِ دُونَ شَرِّهَا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The utmost of one’s power or ability, and the end of one’s case.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression حُدَادُكَ أَنْ تَفْعَلَ كَذَا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The black garments of mourning worn by a widow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal usage distinct from the Quranic sense of sharpness in حِدَاد.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Close, next, adjoining, or neighboring.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of adjoining houses or lands whose boundaries meet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sharp, edged, pointed, penetrating, or pungent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In Classical Arabic this applies physically to blades and teeth and figuratively to speech, intellect, perception, anger, or odor; the Quranic perceptive use is separately listed above.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hard like iron.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied figuratively to especially solid hoofs or comparable objects.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wife.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized lexical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The office or occupation of a door-keeper.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sense is associated with preventing entry.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The craft of a blacksmith or worker in iron, including making coats of mail.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A craft noun derived from work with iron.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A door-keeper or gatekeeper.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The designation is explained through preventing people from entering.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A keeper of a prison.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The role prevents persons from leaving and may involve handling iron shackles.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The person who inflicts the legal punishment called حَدّ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: One reported interpretation of the expression أُجْرَةُ الحَدَّادِ عَلَى السَّارِقِ; another identifies the person as a prison keeper.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A seller of wine or vintner.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sense is explained through withholding the wine until receiving a satisfactory price.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A blacksmith, worker in iron, or maker of coats of mail.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An occupational noun formed from work with iron.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Short and thick, applied to a man.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized descriptive epithet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Deprived or withheld from good fortune, sustenance, or prosperity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sense may also extend to being withheld from evil; it is contrasted with مَجْدُود.

cautions: The QAC Form I and Form III opposition groups are retained as separate public forms because their supplied morphology and Lane constructions differ, despite overlapping English glosses.
The Quranic sharpness sense of حَدِيد is restricted here to the supplied perceptive use; broader physical and figurative sharpness is recorded separately under Classical meanings.
